body:
**Severity:** high. Fix in 0.2.8 (high/medium).

**Who is affected and why it matters:** C# repositories using `@""""` (a verbatim string holding one quote): every symbol and call after it in the file disappears from the graph, silently.

**Reproduce:**
```csharp
class A { void M() { var q = @""""; Helper(); } void Helper(){} void Other(){ Helper(); } }
```

**Actual:** symbols `A`, `A.M` only; no edges.

**Expected:** symbols `A.M`, `A.Helper`, `A.Other`; edges `M → Helper`, `Other → Helper`.

**Done when:** a fixture test fails on `main` and passes.

Found by the 0.2.5 → 0.2.8 quality audit (main at `4369145`); reproduced twice, by the reviewer and independently.
title: C# verbatim strings ending in doubled quotes no longer hide the rest of the file
